A US business on the way to $40M of revenue by 2030; Peak negative cumulative US cash of no more than $18M through 2030; Cumulative US cash back to zero by the end of 2030; Group operating margin at or above 8% in every year; Only one major new-market launch in 2027

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon, not national retail, and cap ad costs at 28.6% of sales so the launch pays back by 2030
The US is the better use of the one 2027 launch, and Onsoo products already sell there
–	US K-beauty facial skincare rose 1.9 times in four years, to $3.6B
–	On plan, the US reaches $26.4M of revenue in 2030; Japan adds $7.0M
A national retail launch fails the board's tests even on its own plan
–	At 4% awareness, sales per door would sit below the retailer's 4.0 cut-off
–	Cash need reaches $20.8M against the $18M cap; group margin falls to 4.5%
The Amazon-led route passes the cash, payback and margin tests on plan
–	Cash need peaks at $1.9M and is repaid in 2030, with about $4.7 kept per unit
Its payback hinges on ad cost: ACoS must stay at or below 28.6%
–	At the 32% benchmark, cumulative cash ends 2030 at −$2.3M
–	Even with a 25% tariff, peak cash need stays at $3.9M, a fifth of the cap
Approve the Amazon launch with four gates; open retail only above 20% awareness
–	Raise the CEO's retail trigger from 15%, and restate $40M as a goal beyond 2030
